name: Pressure Point
source:
With the lack of public toilets in Karachi, Pakistan, Hamid a rickshaw driver is searching for a place where he can urinate. It is a test of his bladder control.

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/pressure_point.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
由于巴基斯坦卡拉奇公共厕所不足，人力车司机哈米德正在寻找可以小便的地方。这是一场考验膀胱控制力的挑战。

[译自[url=http://renai.us/game/pressure_point.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
